text: DATA MANAGEMENT

label: section
text: 1. Policy and Practice

label: content
text: We will ensure that the data obtained and this study will be made available to the research community.

label: content
text: The Bourns College of Engineering (BCOE) at UCR, in partnership with the UCR Libraries and the

label: content
text: California Digital Library, has established a new, custom data management system designed to make

label: content
text: results of our research readily and reliably accessible. This system combines two services of the

label: content
text: California Digital Library (CDL) for the first time: an eScholarship series, a curated site where all BCOE

label: content
text: investigators can store and disseminate their data, and EZID permanent identifiers for long-term

label: content
text: identification and management of data resources.

label: section
text: 2. Scope

label: content
text: This Data Management Plan addresses the NSF policy that primary data “commonly accepted in the

label: content
text: scientific community as necessary to validate research findings” be made available at little or no cost to

label: content
text: the PI or project. In accordance with this policy and guidance from the Office of Management and

label: content
text: Budget, this plan does not include preliminary analyses (including raw data), drafts of scientific papers,

label: content
text: plans for future research, peer reviews, or communications with colleagues. Data that must be withheld

label: content
text: long enough to enable peer review and publication/dissemination or protection of intellectual property is

label: section
text: 3. Data and Metadata Format and Contents

label: content
text: We will make the proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) available to interested investigators who would like to

label: content
text: use them in their scientific research. We will publish our results, and present them results in relevant

label: content
text: conferences, workshops, seminars, and teaching forums. Additionally, we will provide our results to any

label: content
text: national resources and or databases on nanoparticles that compile and maintain such information. As an

label: content
text: example, we will contribute to the nanotechnology information library (NIL)

label: section
text: 4. Accessibility and Data Protection

label: content
text: Materials will be searchable through a number of databases and search engines, including Google and

label: subsection
text: Google Scholar.

label: content
text: As noted in Section 2 (Scope), data will be made available only after appropriate steps

label: content
text: have been taken to protect intellectual property. Confidential material will be handled according to

label: content
text: policies and protocols for human subjects, FERPA, and any other applicable regulations and restrictions.

label: section
text: 5. Derivative Products

label: content
text: All materials will contain acknowledgement of NSF support as per NSF policy: “ This material is based

label: content
text: upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. (NSF grant number). ”

label: section
text: 6. Archiving and Access

label: content
text: It is understood that the NSF Engineering Directorate requires data to be made available for a minimum

label: content
text: of three years after conclusion of the award or public release, whichever is later. If the PI leaves his

label: content
text: institution, the products will remain stored in relevant databases. PI is free to reproduce and repost these

label: content
text: materials at new institution.
